info.title: QRCodeCrafter API
info.description: Generate branded static QR codes in SVG, PNG, JPG, WebP, PDF, or EPS via the QR Code Crafter service.

dynamicQrCampaign.description: Create one to five dynamic QR redirects sequentially. Each row uses createDynamicQr; retain successful one-time management capabilities even when a later row fails. Do not retry a successful row automatically.
dynamicQrCampaign.assetWorkflow: Call generateQr for each successful redirectUrl, or use the visible browser workflow to download one private ZIP with QR assets and JSON/CSV capability manifests.
dynamicQrCampaign.privacy: Management URLs and tokens are unrecoverable secrets. Never publish the manifest or include management capabilities in QR artwork.

post.summary: Generate and verify a QR code asset
post.description: Generate one SVG, PNG, JPG, or WebP asset, perform a structural payload review, assess quiet-zone, contrast, and error-correction settings, decode the final generated file with jsQR, compare payload SHA-256 hashes, and return a bounded evidence-linked receipt. Asset bytes are returned only when final-file decoding matches the requested payload. A decode failure returns HTTP 422 with the full receipt and no asset bytes. The receipt does not include the decoded payload. This is not print, device, ISO, accessibility, malware, or security certification.

post.summary: Generate a ZIP archive of static QR code files
post.description: Create a ZIP archive containing up to 50 static QR code assets plus manifest.csv and manifest.json. Use this for spreadsheet, label, classroom, packaging, and agent batch workflows. The endpoint uses the same QR validation, optional API key, security headers, and cost-weighted rate-limit model as the single-code generator.

post.description: Creates an editable HTTPS destination. The management token is returned only in this response; store it as a secret capability.

delete.description: Requires the current ETag in If-Match. Deletion is irreversible and the printed redirect URL will return 404.

post.summary: Create a capability-managed dynamic QR vault
post.description: Creates a private no-account vault for up to 50 project-owned redirects. The vault management token is returned only by this operation and is never recoverable.

201.description: Vault created with its one-time bearer capability

503.description: Vault storage unavailable or at capacity

get.summary: Read an authorized dynamic QR vault and its public child records

200.description: Vault and project-owned records; never includes token hashes or child management credentials

patch.description: Requires the current vault ETag in If-Match or X-Dynamic-QR-Vault-Version.

delete.summary: Delete an empty dynamic QR vault
delete.description: Requires the current vault ETag. Deletion is non-cascading and fails while the vault contains child records.

post.summary: Create a project-owned dynamic QR record
post.description: Requires the current vault ETag. The child is controlled only by the vault capability; no child token or token hash is returned.

patch.summary: Update, pause, or resume a project-owned dynamic QR record
patch.description: Requires the current child ETag in If-Match or X-Dynamic-QR-Version. The vault version is returned separately when successful.

200.description: Updated public child record without internal ownership or credentials

404.description: Child is not owned by this vault

get.summary: Read aggregate analytics for one project-owned dynamic QR record
get.description: Requires the private vault bearer capability and verifies that the selected child belongs to the vault. Returns approximate aggregate redirect counts only; no visitor identifiers, IP addresses, user agents, referrers, cookies, locations, or device data are stored.

200.description: Aggregate analytics for the selected project-owned redirect. Analytics may be omitted when disabled outside production.

404.description: Child is not owned by this vault

503.description: Vault or child storage temporarily unavailable

delete.summary: Permanently delete a project-owned dynamic QR record
delete.description: Requires the current child ETag. Deletion also removes vault membership and returns the new vault validator.

404.description: Child is not owned by this vault

get.description: Public redirect. When aggregate analytics are enabled, only the slug and UTC count bucket are retained; no IP address, user agent, referrer, cookie, location, device data, or tracking parameter is stored.

head.description: Returns the same status and Location headers as GET without a response body.

value.description: Data encoded in the QR code

format.description: Output format for the QR code asset

size.description: Pixel width/height of the generated asset

margin.description: Quiet-zone margin around the QR code modules

logo.description: Optional base64 data URL for a logo (PNG, JPG, or WEBP) to composite at the center. Files larger than 1MB are rejected.

dataUrl.description: Ready-to-embed data URL built from contentType and base64 data

downloadUrl.description: Relative GET URL for retrieving the generated asset without embedding base64 bytes. Emitted only for no-logo public HTTP(S) URL payloads that do not include obvious credential-style query parameters.

byteLength.description: Exact number of decoded bytes in the base64 data field

qrOptions.description: Normalized QR options used to generate the asset

format.description: Final output format. PDF and EPS are excluded because this workflow decodes the final generated asset.

x-agent-verification.payloadRetention: Request payload is not retained; receipts contain hashes and warning codes rather than decoded payload content.

assetSha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the final generated asset bytes.

error.description: Explains that no asset was returned because final-file decoding did not match the requested payload.

productionReady.description: True only when the final asset decodes to the requested payload and every bounded workflow check passes without caution.

limitation.description: Explicitly states that one software decoder and rendering pipeline do not provide print, device, ISO, accessibility, malware, or security certification.

warnings.description: Namespaced structural warning codes. No decoded payload content is included.

passed.description: Passes when no logo is present or a logo uses H error correction.

rows.description: Up to 50 QR payload rows. Provide either a CSV string with headers such as filename,value or an array of row objects with value and optional filename fields.

format.description: Shared output format for every generated QR file in the ZIP

size.description: Pixel width/height for SVG and raster assets, point size for EPS/PDF QR artwork

margin.description: Quiet-zone margin around every QR code

x-agent-rate-limit.guidance: Prefer SVG for large batches, split PDF/WebP/JPG batches, and request application/zip when a direct ZIP download is preferred over base64 JSON.

value.description: Exact QR payload to encode for this file

filename.description: Optional filename stem. Unsafe characters are replaced before ZIP creation.

name.description: Alternative filename stem accepted for spreadsheet-style rows.

label.description: Alternative filename stem accepted for spreadsheet-style rows.

data.description: Base64 encoded ZIP archive containing QR files plus manifest.csv and manifest.json

fileCount.description: Number of generated QR files in the ZIP

failedCount.description: Number of rows recorded as failed in the manifest

GeneratedAssetDimensions.description: Rendered asset dimensions. Raster and SVG assets use pixels; PDF and EPS use points.

destination.description: Public HTTPS destination. Private, local, reserved, and credential-bearing URLs are rejected.

rotateToken.description: Replace the bearer capability and return the new token once in the response.

managementToken.description: One-time bearer capability. It is never returned by later reads.

DynamicQrAnalyticsSummary.description: Enabled on the production deployment. The analytics property remains optional so non-production or deliberately disabled deployments can omit it.

available.description: False when analytics are enabled but aggregate storage is temporarily unavailable.

approximate.description: Counts are best-effort redirects, not unique people or guaranteed scans.

dailyCountLimit.description: Maximum aggregate redirects counted for one slug in one UTC day. Later eligible redirects still work but are not counted.

totalScans.description: Lifetime aggregate redirect count. Present when analytics storage is available.

managementToken.description: Present only when rotateToken is true; store it because it is not returned again.

DynamicQrVaultRecord.description: Public authorized representation. Never contains managementTokenHash, qrSlugs, child credentials, or internal storage fields.

emptyExpiresAt.description: Empty projects expire after six hours. This is null once the project contains a QR code.

managementToken.description: One-time vault bearer capability, returned only on creation.

DynamicQrVaultId.name: vaultId
DynamicQrVaultId.description: 22-character vault identifier; not sufficient for authorization

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Exact value returned by X-Dynamic-QR-Version, or the ETag when no intermediary has rewritten it

DynamicQrVersionMatch.name: X-Dynamic-QR-Version
DynamicQrVersionMatch.description: Stable mirror of If-Match for intermediaries that rewrite or remove standard conditional headers

DynamicQrVaultVersionMatch.name: X-Dynamic-QR-Vault-Version
DynamicQrVaultVersionMatch.description: Stable mirror of the current vault ETag for intermediaries that rewrite conditional headers

ETag.description: Opaque record version validator for conditional updates

DynamicQrVersion.description: Stable record version validator mirrored separately because some development proxies rewrite ETag

DynamicQrVaultVersion.description: Stable vault version validator. It is distinct from a nested child record validator.

AgentApiKey.name: X-Agent-Api-Key
AgentApiKey.description: Optional API key used when integrations need scoped or rate-limited access.

DynamicQrBearer.description: Private 43-character management capability returned at creation or explicit token rotation.

DynamicQrVaultBearer.description: Private 43-character vault capability returned only when the vault is created. It authorizes the vault and all nested records; child credentials are never exposed.
